about.title: About Barreto, Araque & Asociados
about.lead: Barreto, Araque & Asociados, S.C. is an independent public accounting and professional services firm based in Caracas, supporting businesses across audit, accounting, taxation, financial and administrative advisory matters.
about.body: Established in 2007, the firm combines local professional knowledge with expertise across financial reporting, internal controls, taxation and business administration, supporting organisations in meeting regulatory requirements and strengthening their financial and operational processes.
